quotes.text:
<label control="defaultViewFlags" data-l10n-id="default-flag-label" />
      <radiogroup id="defaultViewFlags"
                  class="indent appearance-options"
                  preference="mailnews.default_view_flags">
        <radio id="defaultFlagUnthreaded"
               value="0"
               data-l10n-id="default-flag-unthreaded" />
        <radio id="defaultFlagThreaded"
               value="1"
               data-l10n-id="default-flag-threaded" />
        <radio id="defaultFlagGrouped"
               value="64"
               data-l10n-id="default-flag-grouped" />
      </radiogroup>

      <separator class="thin"/>

      <html:div class="pane-appearance-sorting-options">
        <label control="defaultSortType" data-l10n-id="default-sort-by-label" />
        <menulist id="defaultSortType" preference="mailnews.default_sort_type">

<richlistitem id="category-appearance"
                        class="category"
                        value="paneAppearance"
                        data-l10n-id="category-appearance"
                        align="center">
            <html:img class="category-icon"
                      src="chrome://messenger/skin/icons/new/touch/paint-palette.svg"
                      alt="" />
            <label class="category-name" flex="1" data-l10n-id="pane-appearance-title"/>

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fixed accepted Appearance controls use label control attributes for defaultViewFlags and defaultSortType, a radiogroup for threading, and localized child radios. The category icon has an empty alt value and a separate localized category label. Keep those control and name relationships when changing the pane. The historical threading control was a menulist; prefer the current structure for this pane. This is structural accessibility evidence only; focus order, speech, contrast and hit areas were not tested. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.
title: Preserve native label targets and decorative icon semantics in Appearance
